case_name: A named face: text, one photo, two photos
group_name: Tool capability: frames from real references
title: Lincoln from a photo, on this shore

turns.text: Here is a photo of Abraham Lincoln and a photo of Moraine Lake. Put him on this exact shoreline in his black suit, crouching to skip a stone across the water. Colour photo, 16:9.

tests: Two references, a face and a place: is the face his and is the shore the photographed one?

answer_sheet.Who and where: Lincoln from the first photo, the shore from the second.

must_haves: The man's face matches the attached Lincoln portrait, not a generic bearded man.
The lake and the peaks behind it match the attached Moraine Lake photo (the same ridge line and the same turquoise water).
He crouches at the water's edge in the act of skipping a stone.
